Movie 'Kaali Kheti' starring Jackie Shroff receives positive reviews

The Hindi film 'Kaali Kheti', featuring actors Jackie Shroff and Sharad Kelkar, has garnered positive reviews. The movie, described as a horror film, is noted for Jackie Shroff's powerful performance and the vision of director Haris Imtiyaz Khan. The film reportedly delves into themes of fear and greed.
